rules: Existing connected, living-rescuer and downed-target checks remain in force.
A revive requires at least three scrap and recipient capacity for three u32 scrap.
On success, debit the rescuer, credit the teammate and revive once.
Insufficient funds stop/reset channel progress; continued held input can resume after funding.
Competing rescuers produce one successful transfer; either authority-accepted winner is valid.
preservation: Feature and probes install only into isolated copies. Original Kit/Scrapyard and the main Replay game remain unchanged.
scope: Source changes and executable behavior, not human authoring time or whole-framework superiority. Save/migration feature acceptance remains separate.
parity_limits: Kit uses owner-clock channels and host consequences; Replay uses scheduled controls and a replayable reducer.
Movement authority and UI/input bindings differ; test participants remain stationary.
